label: PAPER research snapshot from public daily closes; rule outputs, not advice

ema100.rule: ON when a daily close is above EMA100; OFF after 3 consecutive closes below (the bot's regime rule)

ema200.rule: ON when a daily close is above EMA200; OFF after 3 consecutive closes below (the bot's regime rule)

dd90.def: close vs the highest daily close of the last 90 days

vol.def: std of 30 daily log returns x sqrt(365); percentile among the daily readings of the last 365 days

ema50.def: % of the listed pairs whose close is above their own EMA50 (SMA-seeded)

ema200.def: % of the listed pairs whose close is above their own EMA200 (SMA-seeded)

eligible_universe.def: the bot's eligible USDT universe at t (Owner rules, top 40 by 90-day volume), BTC excluded

ema50.def: % of the listed pairs whose close is above their own EMA50 (SMA-seeded)

ema200.def: % of the listed pairs whose close is above their own EMA200 (SMA-seeded)

all_listed.def: every USDT pair in the data snapshot with a close in the last 3 days (incl. memes, stables and ineligible names)

alt_vs_btc.def: equal-weight basket of the pairs listed in `pairs` (tier-2 universe at t) vs BTC, simple returns over the window; rel = (1+basket)/(1+btc)-1

regime.label: risk-on
regime.rule: BTC EMA200 regime ON and close > EMA50 and breadth(EMA200) 90 % >= 50 %

M5-B100.says: alt sleeve 70 % in the tier-2 top-5; core 30 % in BTC
M5-B100.next_review: next Monday close (core: daily; a regime turn-on close enters at the next open)
M5-B100.rule: M5-B100: 70 % tier-2 momentum (S3-M0 rules, BTC EMA200 regime) + 30 % BTC on the BTC EMA100 regime, weekly

C8.says: alt sleeve 70 % in the tier-2 top-5; core 30 % in BTC
C8.next_review: next Monday close (core: daily; a regime turn-on close enters at the next open)
C8.rule: C8: M5-B100 with an own-EMA50 filter on candidates and exact weekly replacement

S3-M0.next_review: next Monday close (or a regime turn-on close)
S3-M0.rule: S3-M0: tier-2 momentum (rel90 rank, universe positions 11..40 without ETH), BTC EMA200 regime, weekly, 5 slots, turnover control

M5-B100-TV.says: alt sleeve 70 % in the tier-2 top-5; core 30 % in BTC
M5-B100-TV.next_review: next Monday close (core: daily; a regime turn-on close enters at the next open)
M5-B100-TV.rule: M5-B100: 70 % tier-2 momentum (S3-M0 rules, BTC EMA200 regime) + 30 % BTC on the BTC EMA100 regime, weekly

tv_overlay.def: scale = min(1, 0.6 / basket vol); basket vol = mean over the held pairs of the annualised std of the last 7 daily log returns (TB-PREDICT M5-B100-TV; NOT a tested edge: it lowered MaxDD in both test periods and cost return)

evidence_alts_when_btc_falls.def: Monday closes from 2020-09-09; forward 28-day simple returns; alt basket = equal weight of the tier-2 universe (positions 11..40 by 90-day volume, no BTC/ETH) at that Monday; regime = BTC EMA200 rule at that close

btc_drop.def: weeks where BTC fell more than 5 % over the horizon

defs.ema: EMA seeded with the SMA of the first n closes (the bot's regime EMA); dist_pct = close / EMA - 1
defs.regime_ema200: ON when a daily close is above EMA200; OFF after 3 consecutive closes below (the A arms and the alt sleeves)
defs.regime_ema100: the same rule on EMA100 (the M5-B100 / C8 BTC core sleeve)
defs.dd90: close vs the highest daily close of the last 90 days, in %
defs.vol: annualised std of daily log returns (30 d); percentile among the last 365 daily readings
defs.breadth: % of pairs with a close above their own EMA50 / EMA200
defs.alt_vs_btc: equal-weight tier-2 basket (eligible universe positions 11..40 by volume, no BTC/ETH) vs BTC over 28 / 84 days
defs.arms: targets recomputed from data only (the live paper state may lag or lead by a day); next fills are at the next open after a Monday close
